    Mojarra frita

    Whole fried fish with rice, black beans, avocado and salad. Also camarones a la diabla, al mojo de ajo and 7 mares.

    $18

    Memelitas & empanadas

    Memelitas with black beans and quesillo. Empanadas of flor de calabaza, huitlacoche, amarillo or mole.

    From $14
    Tejate

    The cold maize and cacao drink from Oaxaca, on the menu next to champurrado, chocolate de agua and café de olla. Plus nieves de leche quemada, tuna and limón for dessert.
